held_corrections.defect: The card files WinGD X-DF as a FOUR-STROKE low-pressure Otto engine in its question framing, 15- and 60-second answers, mechanism list, comparison table header ('4-Stroke LPDF (Wartsila/WinGD)') and trap question, and gives it intake-port gas injection at 4-8 bar. X-DF is a TWO-STROKE low-pressure dual-fuel engine (lean-burn Otto in gas mode, pilot ignition in pre-chambers, gas up to about 13-16 bar), i.e. the direct two-stroke counterpart of the ME-GA.
held_corrections.why_held: Not a bounded edit: the card's comparison is built on the wrong premise. A correct card compares ME-GA and X-DF (both two-stroke LP Otto) and treats four-stroke DF engines (e.g. Wartsila 31DF/46DF) separately. Rewriting engine specifics in haste is how new errors enter.
evidence_held: WinGD, 'Application of WinGD X-DF engines for LNG-fuelled vessels' (2017)
WinGD iCER brochure and May 2022 release (low-pressure EGR, up to 50% methane-slip reduction, Tier III in both modes)
